pages.raw_title: About NRC Health: Healthcare Experience Company Since 1981
pages.raw_meta: NRC Health is a healthcare experience company in Lincoln, Nebraska. For 45 years, we've helped health systems understand patients, consumers, and employees.
raw_blocks: THE POWER OF HUMAN UNDERSTANDING © _______________________
NRC Health is innovating the future of healthcare
For more than 40 years, NRC Health has led the charge to personalize healthcare and support organizations in their understanding of each unique individual.

NRC Health (National Research Corporation) is a healthcare experience company headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. Founded in 1981, we help health systems, hospitals, and medical groups understand and improve the experiences of patients, consumers, and employees. NRC Health draws on insights from 122 million patient and consumer voices.

Our commitment to Human Understanding ® helps leading healthcare systems get to know each person they serve not as point-in-time insights, but as an ongoing relationship. Guided by its uniquely empathic heritage, NRC Health’s patient-focused approach, unmatched market research, and emphasis on consumer preferences are transforming the healthcare experience, creating strong outcomes for patients and entire healthcare systems.
NRC Health is honored to once again be the recipient of the Best in KLAS Award for Healthcare Experience Management in 2026.

Recognized three of the last four years as #1 in the Healthcare Experience Management category, NRC Health continues to lead as a trusted partner enabling healthcare organizations to improve outcomes. Grounded in a deep understanding of real-world healthcare workflows, NRC Health brings together a contemporary platform, proven techniques, and advanced technology, co-designed with its partners.
As part of our organization-wide commitment to data security and privacy, NRC Health attained a HITRUST i1 certification for Patient Experience.
NRC Health proudly celebrates 45 years of advancing Human Understanding ® in healthcare.

For more than four decades, we’ve partnered with healthcare leaders to elevate patient experience, strengthen workforce engagement, and translate insight into measurable improvement. This milestone reflects the trust of our partners and our enduring commitment to seeing every person as n=1.
Picker Institute: NRC Health’s Human Understanding Philosophy embodies the Picker Institute’s principles of patient-centered care →
TGI is a service of NRC Health

The Governance Institute, a service of NRC Health, is a membership organization serving not-for-profit hospital and health system board chairs, board members, healthcare executives, and physician and nurse leaders. Membership services are provided through research and publications, online learning, conferences, and advisory services.
Learn more about TGI →
A new report from The Governance Institute reveals how a shrinking number of boards now oversee larger, more complex systems—without the infrastructure to match.
Do you understand what matters most?
NRC Health helps our partners know each person they serve—behaviors, preferences, wants, and needs—not as point-in-time insights, but in the context of an ongoing relationship.
At NRC Health, we’re building the future of healthcare and your career.
We’re proud to announce the reopening of our newly renovated headquarters in the heart of downtown Lincoln, Nebraska.
We're not just in Nebraska.
NRC Health is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska with remote associates inspiring and delighting customers across the country.
NRC Health – A market leader and proven innovator
Dedicated solely to improving Human Understanding in healthcare
To market with real-time patient experience surveys
PX vendor to create a fully automated discharge call program to reduce unnecessary readmissions
In providing healthcare partners digital channels to provide a holistic, human-centered patient experience
To deploy a robust star ratings and review program to support transparency
With the longest syndicated healthcare consumer study in the nation

pages.raw_title: Healthcare experience management solutions | NRC Health
pages.raw_meta: NRC Health are experts in Human Understanding®. Our healthcare experience management solutions are designed to drive the most human healthcare experiences.
raw_blocks: Healthcare experiences are human experiences
Our expertise is Human Understanding ® . We believe that every healthcare encounter is fundamentally a human experience.
That’s why our holistic healthcare experience management framework is designed to drive the most human healthcare experiences for everyone .
Our comprehensive platform is a next-generation suite of AI enabled products that create a natural way to collect, analyze, and deliver feedback.
By leveraging advanced technology and deep insights, we ensure each interaction becomes a meaningful moment of connection and care.
See how healthcare’s most comprehensive experience management platform helps you listen to those you serve, understand what they are saying, and drive real improvement.
Patients are at the heart of everything we do.
When we view patients as unique humans, we build trust and empathy, paving the way for more meaningful connections.
Humanizing the healthcare experience fosters better communication, which leads to better outcomes.
This vision of seeing people not just patients, drives us to innovate with purpose.
We provide you with the tools to listen and act when it matters most, so you can deliver Human Understanding to every unique individual who walks through your doors.
To best serve your community, you must truly understand them.
We go beyond data and numbers to bring the actual voices, preferences, and perceptions of your healthcare consumers to the table.
No guessing, no irrelevant data.
Just real healthcare consumer input to inform strategic business decisions and co-design experiences.

Our next-gen solutions are designed to fit into real lives, transforming healthcare into a more inclusive and responsive system that makes it easy to acquire and engage consumers beyond the clinical setting.
Employees are the heartbeat of healthcare
The employee experience is a unique journey for everyone. Every interaction, touchpoint, and transaction shapes this journey.
Prioritizing the employee’s point of view can create a more meaningful and productive workplace, and ultimately better outcomes.
Our solutions help to unite your workforce around a shared sense of purpose to attract and retain top talent. And equip leaders with the necessary tools to foster engagement and open communication.
A brand is just a brand if it doesn’t resonate with its market.
To ensure your mission remains relevant and competitive, it’s crucial to ask your market what they want and deliver on those needs.
Stepping outside the traditional care setting allows us to truly understand market demands and adapt accordingly.
Our unmatched insights, specific to healthcare, ensure you can build a brand that is not just recognized, but trusted and valued by the communities you serve.
Our expertise is Human Understanding ®
We are leading the charge towards a future where every unique healthcare experience is a meaningful moment of human connection .
Go beyond the data and truly connect with the individuals who make up your patient base, consumer community, workforce, and the markets you serve.

Since our founding in 1981, NRC Health’s purpose has remained constant: helping organizations understand the patients and families they serve to create extraordinary healthcare experiences. Our expertise is Human Understanding® and we believe that every healthcare encounter is fundamentally a human experience.
